title: Why Does It Rain?
hook: Rain is not the sky crying.
narration: Rain is not the sky crying.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Does It Rain.
Warm air lifts tiny water drops.
Let me show you that in 3D.
They join into heavier drops and fall.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
That fall is rain, and it waters the ground.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Rain is not the sky crying.
The pictures today are a new rain world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why does it rain.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
